recognize_zh: Giemsa 染色下一個大型圓形濾泡：中央為較淡、細胞較大且疏鬆的生發中心，外圍被一圈深藍、密集的小淋巴球外套區包圍，右上角為纖維被膜，是正常次級濾泡的經典低中倍圖。
features: Round secondary follicle with a pale germinal center of larger cells with vesicular nuclei
Scattered clear spaces and macrophages within the germinal center
Surrounding rim of densely packed small dark-blue lymphocytes (mantle zone)
Fibrous capsule at the upper right
Interfollicular small lymphocytes and vessels at the left
describe_en: Giemsa-stained section of lymph node at medium power shows a large round secondary follicle beneath the capsule. The germinal center consists of loosely arranged larger cells with vesicular nuclei and scattered macrophages, and is surrounded by a well-defined mantle zone of densely packed small lymphocytes. The interfollicular area contains small lymphocytes and vessels. Findings are consistent with a normal secondary lymphoid follicle.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are crowded, uniform in size with attenuated mantles and few macrophages, and are BCL2 positive by IHC.
NLPHL nodules are larger and composed of small lymphocytes with scattered LP cells rather than a pale germinal center surrounded by a mantle.
